materiality.rationale: OasisKV presents lookahead sparse prefetching that keeps relevant KV entries in HBM while using higher-capacity memory tiers, with author-measured accuracy and throughput results on vLLM; it matters as a concrete memory-scaling design, while those measurements remain author-reported.

profile_annotations.why_this_issue: This candidate matters because serving beyond HBM is a practical scaling constraint: OasisKV connects tiered memory placement to the latency and quality trade-offs that a Weekly infrastructure item should surface.
